faq.q: What is the new closing time for F&O trading?
faq.a: From August 3, 2026, the Futures & Options (F&O) segment will close at 3:40 PM, extended by 10 minutes from the earlier 3:30 PM.

faq.q: Does this affect my long-term stock investments?
faq.a: For long-term investors who buy shares for delivery, the daily changes from the Closing Auction Session will have minimal impact on your overall investment strategy or portfolio value.

faq.q: Why is this change being made?
faq.a: The change aims to improve the quality of closing prices, make them more representative of the day's supply and demand, and enhance market efficiency and transparency, especially for stocks that are actively traded in the derivatives segment.

faq.q: What happens to my pending orders at 3:15 PM?
faq.a: During the Closing Auction Session, specifically at the transition points, certain pending orders like stop-loss or iceberg orders that fall outside the new price bands might be automatically cancelled. It's advisable to check with your broker for specifics on how they will handle such orders.
